S04.summary: S04: coherent orchestration and traceability. Server: explicit job claim flow (POST /api/jobs/{id}/claim, idempotent for same simulator, 409 for foreign live owners, recovery on expired heartbeat, adoption of unowned sessions), TaskService with transition rules and session ownership (PUT /api/tasks/{id}/status), optimistic concurrency via Version fields on Job/MachiningTask/SimulationSession (409 concurrent_modification), heartbeat expiry monitor marking stale sessions Faulted with owner-heartbeat revival, X-Correlation-Id middleware on all commands/logs/events, TaskStateChanged SignalR event, new error codes (session_not_owned, session_already_claimed, job_not_claimable, invalid_task_transition). Simulator: no more implicit job creation - claims existing runnable jobs, maps pallet slots to backend tasks and reports Running/Completed, sends simulatorId/heartbeats, shows connection/session status, clearly labelled local-only offline demo that never writes to the server. HMI: task traceability (job/session/task ids, pallet, slot, heartbeat, faulted badge), TaskStateChanged live task refresh, duplicate-start fix, command error feedback, en/de/fr i18n. Docs: docs/architecture/ORCHESTRATION.md added, CONTRACTS.md and README updated, TS contracts regenerated.

S06.summary: S06: robot catalog and selectable profiles. Added src/robot/catalog with RobotDefinition/JointDefinition/ToolDefinition contracts, validation (schema, exactly 6 joints, min<max finite joint limits, positive payload/reach, duplicate-id rejection, asset resolution against a procedural asset registry) and a RobotCatalogService with three license-safe generic six-axis profiles (compact 3kg/0.7m, medium 12kg/1.4m, heavy 50kg/2.0m), optional vendor metadata for educational comparison, and end-effector definitions with payload-based compatibility. The current robot is migrated as the default medium-6axis compatibility profile (identical dimensions and joint limits). IndustrialRobot now accepts per-profile joint limits and ScaledRobotComponent is driven by a RobotDefinition, so switching profiles re-mounts the same component with a fresh RobotController (configuration, not scene rewrite; one common controller interface). Added RobotCatalogPanel selection UI + a WebGL-free harness (?view=robot-catalog) for deterministic visual regression. Docs: docs/architecture/ROBOT_CATALOG.md added, EQUIPMENT_SDK.md and README updated.

S08.summary: S08: collision, reachability and trajectory diagnostics. Added src/safety with mesh-independent collision primitives (spheres/capsules/AABBs/planes + deterministic tests with documented tolerances), a SafetyRobotModel whose FK reproduces the visual IndustrialRobot linkage in the cell frame, a cell collision world derived from layout config (CNC body with door opening, conveyor, floor, dynamic pallet rim obstacles, safety zones), reach-envelope target validation, structured SimulationAlarm records with an AlarmLog, and a MotionSafetyEngine that validates joint limits and swept paths before execution (blocking joint-limit/self-collision/obstacle collisions, non-blocking unreachable-target warnings, configurable clearances). The PalletMachiningWorkflow now runs every primary motion through a guarded move: a known collision pauses the workflow before visible penetration and records an alarm identifying the equipment and motion phase. Added a MotionSafetyPanel overlay (reach envelope, check status, alarm list) wired into SingleConveyorCellLayout. Also fixed the DH kinematics model to apply the robot scale so the model matches the rendered robot and the cell world. Docs: docs/architecture/MOTION_SAFETY.md added, README updated.

S45.summary: S45 adds the instructor and class dashboard. Backend: a pure deterministic TrainingMetricsCalculator (DefinitionsVersion 1.0) plus GET /api/training/metrics and the audited, non-destructive POST /api/training/sessions/{id}/restart, both enforced by the Instruct policy and tenant-scoped through the existing repositories; new DTOs and regenerated contracts. HMI: a separate role-gated /instructor route with class selection, scenario/date filters, server-computed aggregate cards and ranked tables, a running/completed session list, a review panel with expected-vs-observed comparison, timeline, typed hint/fault/recovery/safety evidence and server score evidence, and a restart action that names its learner/scenario target behind a confirmation dialog and reports pending/success/failure; EN/FR/DE complete with empty/loading/error/offline states. Tests add InstructorMetricsCalculatorTests and InstructorDashboardHttpTests plus dashboard component/view tests, a live instructor e2e workflow and desktop/laptop visual snapshots. Docs: new INSTRUCTOR_DASHBOARD.md (metric definitions, recorded latency, limitations, educational scope); TRAINING_SESSIONS, HMI_DESIGN_SYSTEM and README updated. The simulator Vitest worker pool is capped (maxWorkers 4, assertions unchanged) so the pre-existing S39/S41 wall-clock benchmarks are deterministic on this 16-core machine.

No production server code changed; connectors remain disabled by default.
